description.p: Oxide360 is a parametric 3D CAD modeller for Linux, written in Rust, in the spirit of Fusion 360. Sketch on planes and faces with constraints and dimensions, turn sketches into exact solids, and change any step later in the timeline.

ul.li: Sketches: lines, rectangles, circles, arcs, splines, text; constraints and dimensions
Solids: extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, holes, threads, fillet, chamfer, shell, patterns
Assemblies: components and joints with motion
Inspect: measure, section analysis, interference, mass properties
Files: STEP, STL, 3MF and OBJ export; STEP and STL import; DXF and SVG sketches
